name: Cummins 6BT (12-valve, 5.9L)
notes: The famous Dodge Ram 12-valve diesel (1989-1998), sourced from wrecked pickups for swaps. Output climbed across its run: 160hp/400lb-ft (1989-93) up to 215hp/440lb-ft (1996-98 manual). 160hp/400lb-ft (542Nm) used here as the baseline. Mechanical injection pump (P7100 on later units), no ECU.
